comment: Catalogue des illustrations générées par tools/illustrate.ts avec ComfyUI (Qwen Image 2.1). Chaque image : un identifiant (son chemin sous public/art/, sans extension), un format, et un sujet. Le style commun précède chaque sujet ; les blasons des pays sont ajoutés par le script, un par nation.
style: Vintage three-color screen print poster, flat areas of ink in dark teal, ochre and off-white, visible halftone dots, slight misregistration between colors, uneven ink coverage, coarse paper texture, simplified shapes, no gradients. One single continuous scene, not split into panels, bands or stripes.

ecran.rules: Off-center composition, cropped figures, no faces in close-up, no real national flags, no text, no letters, no logos.

evenement.rules: Off-center composition, cropped figures, no faces in close-up, no real national flags, no text, no letters, no logos.

doctrine.rules: One strong central motif, readable at a small size, no faces in close-up, no real national flags, no text, no letters, no logos.

batiment.rules: Seen from a slight distance, simple readable silhouette, no people in close-up, no text, no letters, no logos.

paysage.rules: Wide landscape view, low horizon, no people in close-up, no text, no letters, no logos.

blason.rules: A single heraldic shield centered on a plain off-white background, bold simple charges, invented design that does not reproduce any official coat of arms or flag, no text, no letters, no motto, no scroll.

images.subject: A military war room: a few officers seen from behind and in profile around a large map table, one standing apart, a desk lamp, papers and pins on the map, a window at the side.
An abandoned headquarters at dawn: a torn map on the table, scattered papers, an overturned chair, an officer's coat left on a hook, pale light through a broken window.
Soldiers boarding army trucks at night at a border checkpoint, a raised barrier, searchlights sweeping the sky.
A column of tanks crossing a river bridge at dawn, smoke rising on the horizon, a soldier waving them on.

A regional uprising in a small provincial town, seen from a side street: people in coats carrying banners with an invented heraldic animal emblem, an overturned car, smoke from a barricade, a soldier half hidden behind a corner.

Seen from a high window: a few armed civilians piling furniture and tires into a barricade across a narrow old-town street, one carrying a banner with an invented star-and-tower emblem, a burning tram in the background.
Several groups of regional militias, each with its own invented emblem on armbands and banners, meeting at a crossroads in the hills, a map unfolded on the hood of a jeep.
A delegation of townspeople in coats presenting rolled plans to an official in a provincial town hall office, construction cranes visible through the tall window.
A quiet ceremony on a mountain town square: an official lowering a plain banner while another with an invented emblem is raised, a small crowd watching, no weapons.
Two officers from opposing armies facing each other across a small table in a railway carriage, a document between them, a white flag leaning in the corner.
An industrial factory hall with saw-tooth roofs and tall chimneys, freight wagons waiting at the loading dock.
A new road and railway bridge spanning a valley, a freight train crossing, a road with a few trucks below.
A military supply depot: rows of crates and fuel drums under camouflage netting, trucks being loaded, a railway siding.
A line of concrete bunkers and anti-tank obstacles along a ridge, barbed wire in front, trenches behind.
A provincial town under renovation: scaffolding on old facades, a new school, workers paving a square, a crane.
An oil refinery: distillation towers, pipes and round storage tanks, a flare burning at dusk.
A steelworks under a low smoky sky: two blast furnaces, a conveyor belt climbing to the top, glowing molten metal pouring into a ladle, piles of ore in the foreground.
A recruitment center in a town square: young people queueing at the door of a stone building, a few army trucks parked outside.
A modest hospital and a school side by side on a quiet street, an ambulance at the entrance, children crossing.
A naval shipyard: a grey warship hull in a dry dock under tall cranes, sparks of welding.
Flat farmland with wheat fields, hedgerows and a small village with a church steeple.
An industrial plain: factories with chimneys, railway yards, power lines and a city skyline.

A mountain valley with a hydroelectric dam, mines on the slopes and a railway along the river.
